rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: An MCP server providing access to Russia's national vulnerability database (BDU) maintained by FSTEC. Contains 86,000+ vulnerability records with BDU identifiers, supporting full-text search with BM25 ranking, direct record lookup, CVE-to-BDU mapping, and database statistics. Uses SQLite with FTS5 and Cyrillic tokenization. Mirrors geoblocked source data.
